recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球明顯小球性低色素，大小形狀不一，可見大量標靶細胞（target cells）、淚滴狀與碎片狀紅血球，並有一顆有核紅血球（NRBC），整體符合 β 型重度地中海貧血的血片表現。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with predominantly microcytic, hypochromic red cells
Numerous target cells and scattered teardrop cells, fragmented cells and irregular poikilocytes
A nucleated red blood cell with dense pyknotic nucleus (center right)
Occasional larger, paler red cells; no obvious basophilic stippling resolved at this magnification
One leukocyte present; platelets appear adequate in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with a predominance of microcytic, hypochromic red cells. There are numerous target cells, together with teardrop cells, fragmented forms, and irregular poikilocytes, and a circulating nucleated red blood cell is present. Occasional larger pale cells are seen; fine inclusions such as basophilic stippling cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with severe beta-thalassemia (beta-thalassemia major) in the appropriate clinical and hemoglobin analysis context.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells but far fewer target cells and rarely circulating nucleated red cells, with low ferritin.
HbH disease can look similar on smear but shows golf-ball inclusions on supravital brilliant cresyl blue staining and an HbH fast band on HPLC/electrophoresis.
Morphology overlaps, so distinction requires HPLC showing a large HbE fraction in the A2 window along with HbF.
Shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in marrow rather than a globin chain imbalance on HPLC.
